scope: Scientific/history and statistical review of final sections 9-12 and appendices A-D, with earlier sections 1-8 read and reviewed in the drafting phase.

checks.detail: Three old training seeds, warm-started EMA, unequal Fine-only budget, old replay level 0, no 2% endpoint atom, coarse CE learning, and nonuniform/continuous retention split are explicitly distinguished.
Saved-probability CPU recalculation is distinguished from approximately 1.52e-6 network-forward tolerance; trajectory values use the A0 reevaluation CSV.
Fine+RG old checkpoints alone are used for direct coarse generation; three-path values match physical_old_three_paths.csv and are not attributed to Fresh M.
Hamiltonian normalization defines the 512-state conditional joint for fixed exterior; 12 weights times 33 boundaries and MC versus all-plus separation are stated.
Adjacent [0,1,2] and checker [0,2,4] are first-group-only; remaining six spins are serial; model clock is max(n_mask/256,0.01).

Both forward-KL terms are nonnegative and all prefix expectations use P, not model or oracle-generated prefix distributions. Conditional total correlation and checker marginal dependence are explained correctly.

Fixed-boundary examples and all-32-MC-boundary summary use the three old Fine+RG final models, not a mean across all twelve checkpoints. New numerical decomposition audit covers all 396 model-boundary cases.

Whole-chain 10000-draw pointwise intervals are distinguished from the 2000-draw circular-block MC-MC calibration. The latter figure uses a central 90% quantile band and is not a universal noise floor.

The twelve saved M-D/M-F/M-P intervals cross zero; the report distinguishes five point contrasts from three bootstrapped contrasts and preserves the actual 256-field reference with block length eight.
The 120000-draw maximum-zero-difference claim is linked to the original archived independent audits; the text no longer calls it a newly executed review experiment.
Training and validation use the same training-file global chain map 0-5 and 6-7, while physical-reference chains 0-15 belong to a different MC library.
Sections 10-12 label observations, hypotheses and proposed controls; no unrun Fresh direct-coarse sampling, new training, W144 generation, or independent stage C is claimed.
History, trajectory, retention, generation, three-path and 396-case joint links resolve to the intended files. Historical audit counts agree with stored audit JSON.

The long normalized Hamiltonian fraction was replaced by a definition of B_c(x) containing exactly the same internal and boundary spin products, followed by exp(beta_c B_c(x)) normalization. Algebraically identical; reversing only this change exactly restores the previously reviewed report SHA.

findings.detail: Frozen protocol line 125 requires the secondary M-P 97.5% interval upper endpoint below -delta_G. Only coarse M-D/M-F use threshold zero.

recommendations.detail: A.1 now links chain identity directly to B_training_data_metadata.json and MC_reference_metadata.json.
Figure 12d caption states the mean-bar and individual-boundary-point meanings; all-plus results are kept in data and excluded from MC figures.

limitations: This review does not add independent scientific replications or prove large-field joint correctness. No training, network inference, or new generated samples were run by this review.
